applicationName.description: Optional explicit name for the rendered ArgoCD Application. Defaults to a per-cluster derived name to avoid collisions when deployed to multiple clusters.

destination.description: Argo destination for the rendered Application. Provide `server` (cluster URL) or `name` (registered cluster name) — at least one required. Template prefers `name` when both are set. Must resolve to the WORKLOAD cluster: Reloader patches the Deployments that live beside it.

reloadStrategy.description: How a reload is triggered. `annotations` avoids mutating the container spec, which ArgoCD renders from Git and would fight over.

autoReloadAll.description: true reloads every workload without an opt-in annotation. Leave false: combined with watchGlobally it turns one bad Secret write into a cluster-wide restart.

enableHA.description: Leader election. Required before raising replicas above 1, otherwise each replica reloads independently.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the controller container. Empty = upstream default (unset).

extraValues.description: Deep-merged on top of the computed `reloader:` values passed to the upstream chart.
